owner.name: Konrad Waleszczyński
owner.headline: Renewable energy data analytics
owner.intro: Analytics for solar, wind and battery assets: performance verification, fault detection, power market analysis and dashboards. Every project below is written from scratch on open data and can be rerun from its repository, with tests and CI.

data_sources: Kelmarsh wind farm SCADA (Cubico, CC BY 4.0)

projects.title: Polish power market, live
projects.summary: Self-updating dashboard of the Polish electricity market built from PSE open data every afternoon: prices, spreads, negative prices, generation mix and battery potential.
projects.highlight: No server and no database: GitHub Actions rebuilds a static page from cached monthly Parquet files.

projects.title: Battery arbitrage on Polish prices
projects.summary: Mixed-integer dispatch of a battery on 15-minute RCE prices, solved for every delivery day, with sensitivity to duration, efficiency and cycle limits.
projects.highlight: 859-day backtest: a 2-hour battery earned 308 k PLN per MW in 2025, and negative prices reached 354 hours that year.

projects.title: How real batteries trade
projects.summary: One year of 5-minute AEMO data for the 40 batteries of 20 MW or more in Australia's NEM, compared day by day with perfect-foresight arbitrage.
projects.highlight: The six largest batteries earn 11-51 % of their perfect-foresight optimum; the gap is split into capacity offered, volume and timing.

projects.title: Battery state of charge and ageing
projects.summary: State of charge rebuilt from market data and checked against the operator's own SoC, an LFP ageing model fitted to lab cell data, and degradation-aware arbitrage.
projects.highlight: SoC from 5-minute market data tracks the operator's SoC within 2.7-3.8 percentage points (RMSE).

projects.title: PV shading from AC power alone
projects.summary: Sun-path residual fingerprinting finds, draws and costs obstructions from 15-minute AC power, without an irradiance sensor, a site visit or a drone.
projects.highlight: A building's silhouette recovered with mask IoU 0.93 and 0.8 deg RMSE on simulated systems, then run on two years of a real PVDAQ roof.

projects.title: Single-axis trackers in 3D
projects.summary: Row-to-row shading projected onto module cells with a bypass-diode string model: true tracking vs backtracking vs slope-aware backtracking near Poznań.
projects.highlight: Backtracking gives +4.3 % DC yield over true tracking on flat ground (1255 vs 1204 kWh/kWp).

projects.title: PV fault detection: autoencoder vs baselines
projects.summary: A PyTorch autoencoder against a PR threshold, an ASTM E2848 regression and a pvlib model, scored per fault type on 20 injected faults and on real PVDAQ data.
projects.highlight: F1 0.77 against 0.37-0.48 for the baselines; on real data it caught an inverter outage reported 10 days late by the inverter itself.

projects.title: WARP: wake-aware turbine verification
projects.summary: Expected power from the unwaked neighbours carried through a calibrated wake model, with CUSUM charts for power loss, derating, anemometer bias and yaw misalignment.
projects.highlight: Validated on 288 injected faults: a 4 deg yaw misalignment is found in 100 % of cases (median 6 days), standard references find 6-10 %.

projects.title: Wind power curves (IEC 61400-12-1)
projects.summary: Six years of open Kelmarsh SCADA: cleaning with event logs, IEC power curves, underperformance tracking, static yaw misalignment and lost energy.
projects.highlight: Caught a silent change of the SCADA wind speed definition that made the turbines look up to 14 % better than they were.

projects.title: Wakes and shadow flicker
projects.summary: Three PyWake wake models on the real Kelmarsh layout checked against SCADA, plus worst-case and expected shadow flicker maps.
projects.highlight: Measured wake loss 9.2 %: Gaussian model 9.7 %, Jensen 11.4 %, TurbOPark 12.1 %.

projects.title: Fleet monitoring as code
projects.summary: Grafana dashboards, alert rules and datasource generated from Python, fed by a live replay of public wind and PV SCADA into InfluxDB 2.
projects.highlight: Alerts fire on real faults, including a PV inverter that stopped producing ten days before it reported an error code.
